description: Unique Identifier - Patient Surrogate Key to maintain the granularity in the dimension table at the source flag and source market level. Strip the literal prefix of data source 'SHA_PTDONC' (REPLACE(patient_sk,'SHA_PTDONC','')) to derive PATIENT_GID
usage_notes: Use: Link MX activity to patients and combine medical activity with RX activity for patient-level analyses. Limitation: Patient matching depends on consistent patient identifiers across sources.

description: Use: Identify when a patient had qualifying medical activity and create monthly/semesterly activity spines for eligibility and persistence analyses. Limitation: Represents the derived activity period rather than an individual claim date.
usage_notes: Use: Identify when a patient had qualifying medical activity and create monthly/semesterly activity spines for eligibility and persistence analyses. Limitation: Represents the derived activity period rather than an individual claim date.

description: Frequency level at which MX activity is summarized, such as semesterly,yearly.
usage_notes: Use: Select the required activity granularity, e.g., frequency = 'semesterly' for 3-year patient eligibility calculations. Limitation: Results depend on the underlying frequency definition and business rules.

description: Offset identifier used to distinguish the relevant activity-frequency period/version.
usage_notes: Use: Select the required activity period, commonly OFFSET = '0', when building patient eligibility or activity measures. Limitation: Should be used according to the established activity-mapping logic.

description: Identifies the source system/feed from which the claim is derived,(SHA_PTD, PURPLE_LABS or KOMODO).
usage_notes: Use: To select the required claims source and define the appropriate patient population for analysis. Limitation: SHA and KOMODO feeds are not fully interchangeable and may differ in structure and available fields; downstream logic may need to change when switching sources.

description: Identifies the therapeutic market associated with the claim.
usage_notes: Use: To restrict analysis to the required therapeutic area, such as Oncology. Limitation: Should be used with other market/product filters to define the intended patient universe; ONC alone does not define a specific brand or indication.
